chansons.style: Smooth jazz lounge, brushed drums, upright bass, warm saxophone, soft male vocals, melancholic but hopeful vibe, 85 BPM
chansons.resume_fr: Une ballade douce qui évoque la lumière renaissante après une période sombre et difficile.
chansons.paroles:
[Intro]
(Soft upright bass and brushed snare)

[Verse 1]
The shadows stretched across the floor
I couldn't find the exit door
The winter wind was blowing cold

[Pre-Chorus]
But then the clouds began to break
A quiet promise in the wake

[Chorus]
Oh, the dawn is breaking through
Painting all the world in blue
After the storm, the light remains
Washing out the bitter stains

[Verse 2]
I packed my sorrows in a case
And left them in an empty space
The coffee's warm, the morning's bright
I finally stepped into the light

[Pre-Chorus]
The heavy clouds began to break
A quiet promise in the wake

[Chorus]
Oh, the dawn is breaking through
Painting all the world in blue
After the storm, the light remains
Washing out the bitter stains

[Bridge]
(Saxophone solo, smooth and soaring)
Every tear was just a seed
Growing into what I need

[Chorus]
Oh, the dawn is breaking through
Painting all the world in blue
After the storm, the light remains
Washing out the bitter stains

[Outro]
The light remains...
Fading into gold...
(Bass walks down, cymbal swell)
